Name: Wedding Anniversaries - Rasmodius Addition
Author: BackedPotatoes
Description:
This is an add-on for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32078]Wedding Anniversaries[/url] mod﻿! I love this mod, but I only marry Magnus. So I decided to make an addition to it, as the original mod only has generic lines for non vanilla spouses. ^—^


[img]https://i.imgur.com/l20T8HY.png[/img]

[b] ﻿1.[/b] Download this mod
﻿ [b]﻿2.[/b] Drop the folder inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder
﻿﻿Done! You can now play with the new dialogue lines ^^

[img]https://i.imgur.com/I9kOlI4.png[/img]
﻿[list]
[*][size=2]This mod adds [color=#dbb0a7][b]3 wedding reminders + 3 wedding dialogues[/b],[/color] as well as good and bad [b][color=#dbb0a7]gifts options.[/color][/b][/size]
[*][size=2]There's also[color=#dbb0a7] [b]sad dialogue[/b][/color] in case your marriage with him is falling apart... I would never have the courage to do that to him, but I enjoy writing it, and I appreciate anyone who loves the drama! lmao[/size]
[*][size=2]I plan on adding more dialogues and gift options soon ^—^[/size]
[*][size=2]This [b]should [/b]work with RRRR and Female Wizard? But I don't play with either to be able to test it. If anyone tests it, please let me know in the comments![/size]
[/list][size=2]
My thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye [/url]﻿for helping me with this mod!

If you like my mods, you can support my work by buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/backedpotatoes]coffee[/url]!🐱[/size]
